existing.body:
## Original problem

The isolated Depot trial's `trial:depot:ci:source-identity` helper at
`4c4063e78bc9aaed8e293c1b478db089d6eef0ce` checked source HEAD,
tracked Git status,
selected metadata bytes,
and before/after identities.
Its configured-input enumeration omitted tracked inputs:

- `.cargo/config.toml`.
- `package/music-player/android-app/rust/Cargo.toml`.
- `package/music-player/android-app/rust/Cargo.lock`.

The actual original helper accepted each independently changed omitted input in a disposable clone
when `assume-unchanged` hid the edit from Git status.
Each after command exited zero with the saved identity.
A changed hashed `mise.lock` under the same flag was rejected,
so the byte-comparison control was capable of detecting the change when its path was included.

The old helper also relied on Git status for ordinary tracked paths outside its metadata hash subset.
Its source contained no rejection of `assume-unchanged` or `skip-worktree` exclusions.
The ordinary-source masking risk is a source-audited boundary of that original implementation;
the original 15-control record directly reproduced the metadata omissions,
not an additional old-revision ordinary-source test.
The final 12-control record directly measures both flags on ordinary source outside the metadata set.

This is a trial-helper integrity incident.
No provider run was proved to have changed these files or enabled the flags.
The historical source bytes were not repaired or rewritten.

## Verified corrections

- `c0baaeb1d6` expands metadata enumeration to root configuration,
  root `.cargo/` inputs,
  and nested metadata inside selected or artifact-prerequisite packages.
- `faf388e838737e6b08b9a8075cdcbf4b34f02b2b` uses NUL-delimited tracked paths.
  The actual helper hashes the three former omissions and rejects their hidden edits.
  A private metadata path containing spaces,
  single/double quotes,
  and a newline is hashed correctly;
  its hidden edit is rejected and its restored after control passes.
- `a07d84a129f0dd16861551adfb76b1a3bbc4083d` independently rejects index exclusions before tracked status.
  The actual helper rejects both unchanged flags and hidden edits to ordinary
  `package/music-player/truepeak-core/src/lib.rs`,
  which is outside the metadata hash list.
  Git status is empty in each rejection control.
  Both `assume-unchanged` and `skip-worktree` are covered.
  Restored ordinary source and unflagged adversarial metadata pass.

The final diagnostic is:

```text
Immutable source index must not hide tracked inputs with assume-unchanged or skip-worktree flags
```

The metadata hashes remain a selected evidence subset,
not an exhaustive byte inventory of every tracked source file.
The independent index invariant prevents those flags from hiding paths outside the subset.
Its deliberate tradeoff is that indexed exclusions are incompatible with this fully checked immutable-source gate,
even when the excluded bytes currently equal HEAD.
Untracked files and ignored build outputs remain outside this helper's contract.

## Acceptance and retained evidence

- [x] The omitted root and nested Cargo metadata is hashed and compared to committed Git blobs.
- [x] NUL path boundaries preserve spaces,
  quotes,
  and newlines through enumeration,
  blob reads,
  JSON persistence,
  and identity comparison.
- [x] Both index flags are rejected for unchanged ordinary source and for hidden ordinary-source edits.
- [x] Both historical before/after pairs remain accepted:
  `cb95cf6d785c3073c192b95f0632cdae7b910894` and `3434eaa455d569c18b52cf15100f77f9db251d21`.
  Their source heads,
  trees,
  configured bytes,
  manifest hashes,
  and clean tracked status are retained.
- [x] The original 15-control,
  metadata/path repair 19-control,
  and index-invariant 12-control records remain separate.
- [x] The indexed-exclusion tradeoff and selected metadata hash boundary are explicit.

The pushed default-branch evidence is:

- [Original 15 controls](https://github.com/Aquaticats/Monochromatic/blob/main/doc/audit/depot-source-identity-controls-2026-10-17.evidence.json),
  committed in `1022ae62aae4b37871e393754e6fd7984be6e219`.
- [Metadata/path repair 19 controls](https://github.com/Aquaticats/Monochromatic/blob/main/doc/audit/depot-source-identity-repaired-controls-2026-10-17.evidence.json),
  committed in `858d9fb21ed0902d9b3e5e3208e13e82b0be4a5e`.
- [Index-invariant 12 controls](https://github.com/Aquaticats/Monochromatic/blob/main/doc/audit/depot-source-identity-index-controls-2026-10-17.evidence.json),
  committed in `c1eee586d54d30a081897ee704473ac71b6115ed`.
- [Troubleshooting diagnosis and scope](https://github.com/Aquaticats/Monochromatic/blob/main/doc/troubleshooting/depot-historical-checkout-bootstrap.md#source-identity-input-coverage).

Verification used actual task invocations and disposable mutation fixtures.
Shared historical source worktrees and shared harness task bytes remained unchanged during the controls.
No cloud run or broad application test suite was dispatched for this verification.
Closing this helper-specific incident does not claim production workflow adoption,
passing application tests,
or a final coherent provider replay.

## Duplicate search

All-state current-repository searches covered `"source identity"`,
`"source-identity"`,
`"immutable" "checkout"`,
`"immutable source"`,
`"assume-unchanged"`,
`"skip-worktree"`,
and `"index" "mask"`.
No matching helper incident was found.
The source-identity mentions in #1108 concern a missing desktop tool wave;
#1113 concerns mutation timeout and lost evidence.
Neither is this input enumeration/index-exclusion incident.
